notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures, one of which must have a power of one or greater.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any creature with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on any creature you control equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
